findings.current: One thing was certain: Taekyung had far surpassed his original goal.
findings.defect: The possessive grammatically makes the original goal Taekyung’s, but the surrounding source identifies it as the training goal Jin Mukyung had set.
findings.rationale: Jin Mukyung first recalls his initial estimate, then immediately explains what he had intended to accomplish through the training. Taekyung exceeded Mukyung’s target; the source does not establish an original goal belonging to Taekyung here.
findings.replacement: One thing was certain: Taekyung had far surpassed the goal Jin Mukyung had originally set.

summary: The chapter is highly faithful overall; one localized pronoun ambiguity misattributes Jin Mukyung’s training goal to Taekyung.
